# Plots

The grid of every house size and of a group room. Use `target: "home"` with a `tier`, or `target: "room"`.

## starter: Starter house

- Plot 6 wide (x 0–5) by 6 deep (y 0–5), 1 floor. Front door on the side wall at x 0, y 4; window on the back wall at x 3.
- Floor 0: Room x0–5 y0–5.

## bq: Two-room house

- Plot 12 wide (x 0–11) by 8 deep (y 0–7), 1 floor. Front door on the side wall at x 0, y 6; window on the back wall at x 4.
- Floor 0: Room x0–7 y0–7; Second room x8–11 y0–4; Bath & toilet x8–11 y5–7.

## bungalow: Bungalow

- Plot 15 wide (x 0–14) by 14 deep (y 0–13), 1 floor. Front door on the side wall at x 0, y 8; window on the back wall at x 5.
- Floor 0: Parlour x0–9 y0–9; Bedroom x10–14 y0–4; Second bedroom x10–14 y5–9; Kitchen x0–5 y10–13; Bath & toilet x6–9 y10–13; Dining x10–14 y10–13.

## duplex: Duplex

- Plot 18 wide (x 0–17) by 16 deep (y 0–15), 2 floors. Front door on the side wall at x 0, y 10; window on the back wall at x 6.
- Floor 0: Parlour x0–11 y0–11; Dining x12–17 y0–5; Kitchen x12–17 y6–11; Guest toilet x0–4 y12–15; Hall x5–17 y12–15.
- Floor 1: Master bedroom x0–11 y0–11; Bedroom x12–17 y0–5; Bath & toilet x12–17 y6–11; Balcony x0–4 y12–15; Landing x5–17 y12–15.
- Stairs from floor 0 at x7–12 y14–15: keep them and one tile at each end clear.

## villa: Villa

- Plot 21 wide (x 0–20) by 18 deep (y 0–17), 3 floors. Front door on the side wall at x 0, y 12; window on the back wall at x 7.
- Floor 0: Parlour x0–13 y0–13; Dining x14–20 y0–6; Kitchen x14–20 y7–13; BQ x0–4 y14–17; Hall x5–20 y14–17.
- Floor 1: Master bedroom x0–8 y0–13; Family lounge x9–13 y0–13; Bedroom x14–20 y0–6; Bath & toilet x14–20 y7–13; Balcony x0–4 y14–17; Landing x5–20 y14–17.
- Floor 2: Roof terrace x0–20 y0–17.
- Stairs from floor 0 at x8–14 y16–17: keep them and one tile at each end clear.
- Stairs from floor 1 at x8–14 y14–15: keep them and one tile at each end clear.

## room: group room

- Plot 10 wide (x 0–9) by 10 deep (y 0–9), 1 floor. Front door on the side wall at x 0, y 8; window on the back wall at x 5.
- Floor 0: Room x0–9 y0–9.
